answer: Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 45% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned thus nobody profits from it. An operator that moves capital between 171 aliases as a result destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 5 dollars per alias.
